<function name="OpenMenu" parent="SpawnIcon" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Called when right clicked on the SpawnIcon. It will not be called if there is a selection (<page>Panel:GetSelectionCanvas</page>), in which case <page>SANDBOX:SpawnlistOpenGenericMenu</page> is called.
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
</function>
